title: Find the Courier
description: The courier is at the foot of the watchtower stair, dead longer than four days. His purse is still on his belt, coin and all. The letter is still sealed in his coat.

objectives.description: Search the Old Watchtower for the courier
Take the sealed letter from his coat

notes: Turn (per REWRITE_SPEC): the courier was not robbed - purse and letter both intact. Reads as accident or misadventure, not banditry. Left unresolved. No bible basis - local colour.
